auth.email_subject_verify_email.description: Subject of the email verification message.

auth.email_body_verify_email.description: Body of the email verification message. {{.Link}} is the verification URL.
auth.email_body_verify_email.other: Welcome to Lahijan. Please verify your email by opening this link within 24 hours: {{.Link}}

auth.email_body_reset_password.description: Body of the password-reset email. {{.Link}} is the reset URL.
auth.email_body_reset_password.other: You requested a password reset. Open this link within 1 hour to choose a new password: {{.Link}}. If you did not request this, you can safely ignore this email.

auth.email_body_email_changed.description: Body of the email-changed notice. {{.NewEmail}} is the new address.
auth.email_body_email_changed.other: Your Lahijan account email was changed to {{.NewEmail}}. If this was not you, contact your operator immediately.

auth.err_email_taken.other: An account with this email already exists.

auth.err_email_unverified.other: Please verify your email before logging in.

auth.err_invalid_token.other: This token is invalid, expired, or already used.

auth.err_refresh_reuse.other: Refresh token reuse detected; all sessions for this login have been revoked.

auth.err_password_too_weak.other: Password is too weak. Use at least {{.Min}} characters with a mix of letters, digits, and symbols.

auth.err_email_invalid.other: A valid email address is required.

auth.err_pat_expired.other: This personal access token has expired.

auth.err_forbidden.other: You do not have permission to do that.

auth.err_internal.other: Something went wrong. Please try again.

auth.err_pat_name_required.other: A name is required for the personal access token.

auth.err_scopes_invalid.other: One or more requested scopes are not allowed.

auth.msg_email_sent.other: If that account exists, an email is on its way.

auth.msg_pat_revoked.other: The personal access token has been revoked.

auth.msg_identity_unlinked.other: The identity provider has been unlinked from your account.

auth.action_login_with_sso.description: Button label / link text the dashboard renders for the SAML SP-initiated login flow.

auth.err_idp_disabled.other: External identity providers are not enabled on this server.

auth.err_idp_unknown.description: Returned when the path {provider} does not match a configured IdP. {{.Provider}} is the unknown key.

auth.err_idp_state_invalid.other: The login session expired or was tampered with. Please try again.

auth.err_idp_exchange_failed.other: The identity provider rejected the login code. Please try again.

auth.err_idp_already_linked.other: This identity is already linked to an account.

auth.err_idp_linked_elsewhere.other: This identity is linked to a different account.

auth.err_idp_last_auth_method.description: Returned when removing the identity would leave the user with no way to log in.
auth.err_idp_last_auth_method.other: You cannot remove your last remaining way to log in. Add a password or another identity first.

auth.err_idp_jit_disabled.description: Returned when a SAML login resolves an unknown (provider, name_id) and just-in-time user creation is disabled.
auth.err_idp_jit_disabled.other: This account is not yet linked to your organisation's login. Contact your operator to be added.

auth.err_mfa_required_unenrolled.description: Returned when login is blocked because the tenant requires MFA but the user has no factor enrolled.
auth.err_mfa_required_unenrolled.other: Your organisation requires multi-factor authentication. Please enroll an MFA factor before logging in.

auth.err_mfa_pending_not_found.other: The MFA session has expired. Please log in again.

auth.err_mfa_pending_expired.other: The MFA session has expired. Please log in again.

auth.err_mfa_pending_consumed.other: This MFA session has already been used. Please log in again.

auth.err_mfa_pending_revoked.other: This MFA session was revoked due to too many failed attempts. Please log in again.

auth.err_mfa_too_many_attempts.description: Returned after 5 consecutive failed MFA challenges against the same pending session.
auth.err_mfa_too_many_attempts.other: Too many incorrect codes. The MFA session has been revoked; please log in again.

auth.err_mfa_invalid_challenge.other: That code didn't match. Please try again.

auth.err_mfa_not_enrolled.other: This MFA factor is not enrolled.

auth.err_mfa_already_enrolled.other: This MFA factor is already enrolled. Disable it first if you want to re-enroll.

auth.err_mfa_password_required.other: Your current password is required to disable MFA.

auth.err_mfa_disabled.other: MFA is not enabled on this server.

auth.msg_mfa_totp_enrolled.other: Your authenticator app is now set up. Enter the 6-digit code to confirm.

auth.msg_mfa_recovery_regenerated.other: A fresh batch of recovery codes has been generated. Save them now — they will not be shown again.

rbac.err_tenant_scope_required.description: Returned when a privileged endpoint is called without the X-Tenant-Id header.
rbac.err_tenant_scope_required.other: A tenant scope is required for this action. Set the X-Tenant-Id header.

rbac.err_permission_denied.description: Generic denied message for non-HTTP callers (jobs, websockets).

audit.err_forbidden.other: You do not have permission to read the audit log.

audit.err_internal.other: Could not read the audit log. Please try again.
